title: The Five Structures the Living Spirit Built into the Bodies of the Bound Archons
arc: The teaching enumerates the five great fixed structures by which the Living Spirit established cosmic order through the very bodies of the conquered archons — bearing, ascent, binding, foundation, and boundary — so that Divine Wisdom rules the natural through the channels of the proprium itself.
reading:
This chapter takes up a single subject: the five great structures that the Living Spirit ("the Living Projection") established in the bodies of the strong archons, working through their veins and canals — that is, through the very channels of communication that exist in the bound powers of self-love. The premise is the Manichaean cosmogonic principle that the cosmos is not built out of nothing but is built out of the captured bodies of the archons, which the divine Builder takes and orders into a vessel of redemption. Read correspondentially: Divine Wisdom does not abolish the proprium when it conquers it; it rather restrains, fixes, and re-purposes its own conducting structures (its "veins," its channels of natural communication) so that the natural mind, even in its mingled state, can serve the work of regeneration. Five fixed structures are named because Five is the complete natural-rational organization — the standard measure by which divine order is articulated in the receptive degree.

The first is the disc set upon the shoulder of Omophoros. This is the lowest support: the patience of Divine Wisdom that bears up the whole natural cosmos in ultimates. Everything else rests on this bearing-up; without the divine bearing of the burden of the natural, no further structure could stand.

The second is the forepart of the Pillar that stretches through the midst. This is the Pillar of Glory — the axis of ascent on which all redeemed light returns home. From the Omophoros below, the Pillar rises through the middle of the cosmos as the column by which accumulated truth is conveyed upward. Where the first structure bears, the second lifts.

The third is the molding of the formation of the Gehennas. This is the divine work of binding: the fashioning of those fixed places in which the unredeemable residue of falsity is to be confined. Just as the Living Spirit shapes pillars and bearers for the ascending light, he also shapes the binding-houses that hold falsity in its bondage. Order in the heavens requires order in the hells.

The fourth is the pillars that stand on their feet in the great sea, in the seventh kind of the cosmos. The "great sea" is the natural mind in its receptive depth — the salty mingled-state of natural affections — and "seventh" marks fullness in ultimates. These pillars do not rise through the middle (as the Pillar of Glory does); they stand planted in the lowest receptive natural, fixing the foundations of the cosmos at the very bottom of the mingling. They are how Divine Wisdom plants firm supports in the very sea of corrupt affection.

The fifth is the four walls that surround the strongholds. Where the previous structures are vertical (bearing, rising, planting), this last is the boundary in extension — Four signifying ordered fullness in all directions. The walls enclose the strongholds, the binding-houses where confined falsity is held. They are the protecting truth that prevents evil from breaking out beyond the limits permitted to it.

Taken together, these five form a complete architecture of restraint and ascent built into the bodies of the conquered archons: a bearer beneath, a rising column through the middle, the molded prisons of the Gehennas, the pillars planted in the lowest sea, and the four-fold wall around the binding-states. This is the Living Spirit's structuring work in its full extent — Divine Wisdom not destroying the proprium but fixing it as the very framework in which the Living Soul can be carried, gathered, and finally redeemed. The teaching's quiet point is that the cosmos we inhabit is itself this five-fold structure: every bearing, ascent, binding, foundation, and boundary in the natural order is a station built by the Lord through the captured channels of the very powers that opposed him.
